targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(overall_score), 0) AS value FROM question_quality_judgments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN passed THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0) AS value FROM question_quality_judgments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(groundedness_score), 0) AS value FROM question_quality_judgments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(answer_correctness_score), 0) AS value FROM question_quality_judgments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT created_at AS time, AVG(groundedness_score) AS groundedness, AVG(answer_correctness_score) AS answer_correctness, AVG(clarity_score) AS clarity, AVG(difficulty_score) AS difficulty FROM question_quality_judgments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY created_at ORDER BY created_at

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1h'), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE passed) AS passed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT passed) AS failed FROM question_quality_judgments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT assigned_difficulty, AVG(groundedness_score) AS groundedness, AVG(answer_correctness_score) AS answer_correctness, AVG(clarity_score) AS clarity, AVG(difficulty_score) AS difficulty FROM question_quality_judgments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY assigned_difficulty ORDER BY assigned_difficulty

SELECT created_at, judge_status, passed, overall_score, groundedness_score, answer_correctness_score, clarity_score, difficulty_score, assigned_difficulty, judge_model, source_paths, question_text FROM question_quality_judgments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
